{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# Ensure sample_seq is int64 and use groupby with idxmax
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Check distribution of severity across sites
severity_site = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['severity'])
print(severity_site)

# Also check total counts per site
total_per_site = df['site'].value_counts()
print(total_per_site)"}
